physicalNotes: Radius 1.021 +/- 0.038 solar radii from Dattilo et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6109 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..318D/abstract): 710,310 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
